description: Every marketing screenshot used by index.html and deck.html. Source of truth for the shot library: scripts/make-screenshots.mjs renders placeholders from it, tests/screenshots.test.mjs guards it. Capture recipes per shot are in assets/img/screenshots/README.md.

capture.theme: VS Code Dark+ (default dark), zoom level 1

shots.title: Work Items — Epic → Feature → Story → Task tree
shots.alt: VS Code with the ADO Code activity bar open, showing a work item tree with an Epic expanded into features, stories and tasks with state icons.
shots.caption: Your Azure DevOps hierarchy, fetched into a real editor tree.
shots.capture: Open the ADO Code view, expand 'Payment Platform Overhaul' all the way to Task level so the Epic → Feature → Story → Task indentation and state icons are visible. Workspace: ado-demo. Keep the sidebar at ~320px so the whole tree fits without horizontal scroll.

shots.title: Agent chat — plan card, tool calls, streamed diff
shots.alt: Agent chat panel showing a numbered implementation plan, a list of tool calls with status ticks, and a streamed code diff in the editor beside it.
shots.caption: Plan first, then execute — with a visible tool trail.
shots.capture: In Agent mode, run a story such as 'Add retry with jitter to PaymentClient'. Capture while the plan card and at least three tool calls (read_file, apply_diff, run_tests) are on screen and the diff is open next to the chat.

shots.title: Delegated run — isolated worktree, branch, live log
shots.alt: Run card for a delegated agent showing the isolated git worktree path, generated branch name and a streaming progress log.
shots.caption: An isolated git worktree and branch per delegated run.
shots.capture: Trigger 'Delegate to agent' on a work item and capture the run card with worktree path, branch name and at least five log lines plus the run header (work item id and title).

shots.title: Finished run — gates green, pull request created
shots.alt: Completed run card showing verification gates marked as passed and an Azure DevOps pull request link created for the run branch.
shots.caption: Green gates, then a real pull request.
shots.capture: After a run finishes green, capture the run card with the gate summary (tests, lint, build) and the created pull request row with its id and link.

shots.title: Consent card with live auto-approve countdown
shots.alt: Chat consent card asking permission to run a terminal command, with a live countdown reading that it auto-approves when the timer expires.
shots.caption: Every consent card counts down what happens next.
shots.capture: Trigger a command that needs consent and capture the card mid-countdown ('Auto-approving in 0:17') with the command line fully visible.

shots.title: Persistent memory — user and project scopes
shots.alt: Memory panel listing user-level and project-level notes that the assistant carries across sessions and work items.
shots.caption: User and project memory that survives the session.
shots.capture: Open the memory view with both scopes populated (three or more entries each) so the user/project split is obvious.

shots.title: MCP servers and skills manager
shots.alt: MCP, servers and skills manager listing a connected server, its available tools and installed skills.
shots.caption: MCP servers and skills, wired in from one panel.
shots.capture: Open the MCP/skills manager with one server connected and its tool list expanded, plus at least two installed skills.

shots.title: Command palette filtered to ADO Code
shots.alt: VS Code command palette filtered to the ADO Code prefix, listing extension commands such as refresh work items and switch mode.
shots.caption: Every command one palette keystroke away.
shots.capture: Press Ctrl+Shift+P and type 'ADO Code:' so roughly ten command rows are listed, then capture the palette over the editor.

shots.title: Work item webview — criteria, comments, history
shots.alt: Work item webview in the editor showing the description, acceptance criteria list and discussion comments.
shots.caption: The whole work item in the editor: description, acceptance criteria, comments and history — no browser round trip.
shots.capture: Open a story from the tree and capture the webview scrolled so the description and acceptance criteria block are both visible.

shots.title: Verification gates before the push
shots.alt: Run card listing verification gate results for tests, lint and build, with one gate expanded showing command output.
shots.caption: Nothing ships unverified: tests, lint and build gates must pass before the run is allowed to push.
shots.capture: Capture a finished run with at least one gate expanded so its command output is readable.

shots.title: Mode selector — Ask, Plan, Agent, Auto
shots.alt: Chat input area with the mode selector open, listing the Ask, Plan, Agent and Auto modes with short descriptions.
shots.caption: One toggle from ask to autonomy.
shots.capture: Open the mode dropdown above the chat input and capture it with all four modes and their descriptions visible.

shots.title: Mermaid diagram rendered inline in chat
shots.alt: Chat message containing a rendered Mermaid flow diagram with connected boxes for a request flow.
shots.caption: Architecture answers rendered inline as Mermaid.
shots.capture: Ask the chat to 'diagram the request flow' and capture the rendered diagram together with the surrounding message text.
